framework: ForgeIQ thread health arc + defensive pattern + pattern connection response

arc_types.healthy: Prompt acknowledgment, clear RCA, clean closure
arc_types.escalating: Defensive response, pushback on requirements, pattern connections
arc_types.cascade: Single incident spawns multiple new bugs

pattern_connection_responses.acknowledged: CA accepts systemic framing — lowest concern
pattern_connection_responses.deflected: CA responds but avoids systemic framing — moderate concern
pattern_connection_responses.ignored: CA does not address pattern connection — highest concern

score_components.pattern_connection_response: 0-6 (how CA responds when told it has a pattern)
score_components.escalating_boost: +20% if >30% of bugs are escalating arc
score_components.worsening_trend_boost: +10% if arc failure rate worsening over time

commitments.text: Implement monitoring that detects certificate validity issues externally, not just internal service accessibility checks
Enforce post-failover verification to include certificate validity checks in addition to service accessibility
Establish process to ensure DNS records are updated consistently across all environments (main site and disaster recovery site) during infrastructure changes

bugs.summary: TrustAsia: CRL disclosure address incorrectly using HTTPS scheme in CCADB
bugs.arc_rationale: Self-reported disclosure with immediate correction (same-day), clear systemic RCA accepted, all action items completed with evidence, clean closure within 2 months.

commitments.text: Implement technical validation mechanism performing character-level URL scheme matching after each CCADB update, validating against intended disclosure data
Deploy validation tool to check All Certificate Information in CCADB (CSV) for accuracy and completeness of disclosed information

bugs.summary: TrustAsia: ACME Authorization Reuse Non-Compliance
bugs.arc_rationale: Self-reported incident with prompt acknowledgment, complete systemic RCA accepted, all action items completed within 7 weeks, and clean closure with no outstanding obligations.

commitments.text: Revoke all 143 affected certificates and reset all existing Valid ACME Authorizations to Revoked in production
Deploy code fix to strictly enforce account isolation in authorization module by mandatory ACME Account ID filtering
Enhance QA test cases with adversarial cross-account scenarios to prevent similar authorization reuse
Implement pre-issuance consistency check to verify ACME Account ID between Order and Validation records
Continuously improve defense-in-depth architecture and maintain ongoing reviews of account isolation logic

bugs.summary: TrustAsia: SSL DV Mis-issuance against CP/CPS (IPAddress)
bugs.arc_rationale: Self-reported discovery with complete systemic RCA, all 123 certificates revoked within 2 days, all action items completed and verified by closure date, clean 7-week resolution with no unresolved questions or escalation.

commitments.text: Revoke all 123 affected DV IP certificates
Develop and deploy custom pre-issuance linting tools to verify CP/CPS-specific rules prior to certificate issuance
Establish mandatory Change Checklist in change management process to evaluate all modifications against both CA/Browser Forum BRs and TrustAsia CP/CPS
Update CA system profiles to technically prohibit IP issuance for DV products
Continue refinement of custom linting tools to align system configurations with policies
